_comment: Rules for the npc-anims target, which stamps `anims` on an npcs.json entry
whose model borrows animation packs from elsewhere in the archive.
A trust — a party NPC with a full player-style move set — does not carry
its combat clips in its own DAT. It declares them by reference: alongside
its own root FourCC the model DAT holds Directory (0x01) sections naming
other content families, and the packs are the DATs whose *root* FourCC is
one of those names. Both Iroha models (ROM/310/3, ROM/310/4) name 'iro_';
17 DATs have that root and the 6 carrying a SkeletonAnimation are
ROM/338/15 through ROM/338/20 — exactly the set found by hand.
The section *type* is what makes this clean. Gear ids in the same DAT
(hf_1, hf_e, …) appear as SkeletonMesh/Texture and cait/corp as
EffectRoutines, so only real content families are typed Directory.
_maxFamilySizeComment: A Directory id that names more DATs than this is a *shared* vocabulary
rather than one entity's own pack, and is skipped. Measured: 'iro_' (the
Iroha family) reaches 17 DATs; 'mot_', the race-wide motion set a goblin
declares, reaches 3658. Anything in between would want a look before the
